jobs.description:
**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Are you motivated by working in a growing company which develops cutting edge products in the laser industry? Hamamatsu Photonics is an exciting, inspiring place to work where we encourage both personal and career development. To support our plans, we are now expanding our team as we are looking for Senior Electronics Engineers.

**About Us

**Hamamatsu Photonics is a dynamic, international high-tech company and a leader in the development, manufacturing, and supply of high-performance lasers and photonic crystal fibers. We employ some of the best and most creative people in our industry and together we have established one of the fastest growing and most innovative photonics companies in the world.

We embrace a culture in which a healthy work-life balance is encouraged; and we promote a positive, supportive working environment. To support our growth plans, we are investing in our facilities and growing our talented teams. We provide a great place to work with good people and exciting, industry-leading products.

**THE ROLE

**You will be working with a mix of custom-made technologies and ground research. You will design, develop and implement electronic systems and laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle. You will closely collaborate with experts in your own and other fields to meet the demanding requirements. The products you develop are typically low volume but high margin, reflecting the complexity and effort put into each system. You are prepared to learn to interpret and scope fuzzy customer requirements.

• Be responsible for Electronics development for laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Work closely with experts from other areas like optics and mechanics on system design.

• Take ownership of project work packages within product development projects; work with project managers to ensure delivery of solutions within the planned deadlines and budgets.

• Interact with project and product stakeholders and communicate information clearly across the R&D organization.

• Form new and innovative design concepts and take ownership of electronics system designs.

• Create reference designs for other electronics designers in our organization.

• Support manufacturing of existing laser products, custom orders, product improvement activities.

• Ensure product compliance and certification according to industry standards

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

**

• Experience from senior roles in developing advanced PCBs for complex systems spanning the complete product life cycle.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills engaging with management and other engineering disciplines.

• Proven track record of successful PCB productization.

• Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following areas: analog design, power supplies, control loops, digital interfaces or low noise designs.

• Detailed knowledge of state of the art electronic and software technologies.

• Experience of working with external partners.

• A scientific mindset, out of the box thinker but still with a practical approach.

• Master’s degree in electronics or similar.

• English – both oral and written

**WE OFFER

**Professional challenges in a highly dynamic and growing business environment with enormous potential for further growth. An opportunity to become part of a successful, enthusiastic, development team in an informal workplace. Competitive employment terms and benefits, good work-life balance, and influence on own tasks. Experienced and skilled colleagues with highly diverse backgrounds in an international organization.

**APPLY TODAY

**We plan to invite candidates for interviews as soon as possible. If you think you have what it takes, please send your CV and a brief cover letter (in one document) to us and we will be in contact soon.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Based at our welcoming Roskilde office, you will join the Workplace department, which develops and maintains BEC’s cloud-based Microsoft platform, including SharePoint and Microsoft 365 administration services, for BEC and our 25 Danish banking customers.

As a Senior Microsoft 365 Platform/System Engineer, you will join a team of dedicated professionals focused on developing SharePoint and Microsoft 365 within our Modern Workplace services.

You will be part of a cross-country, agile Microsoft 365 team comprising 12 dedicated professionals.

At BEC, we value regular in-office collaboration while offering flexibility to work remotely for up to eight days per month. You will report to Anne-Mette Bluhme.

**Your primary tasks and responsibilities will include:

**

• Developing and managing SharePoint Online Services

• Administering and maintaining the Microsoft 365 suite, including Copilot, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams and OneDrive for Business

• Ensuring the availability, performance, and security of these services

• Implementing and managing security controls for Microsoft 365 environments, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements

• Participation in development projects of new services

• Developing and maintaining PowerShell scripts to automate administrative tasks and improve efficiency

• Handling second-line Microsoft 365 incidents and service requests

**To succeed in this role, you should have:

**

• Solid experience in SharePoint development and maintenance

• Solid experience administering Microsoft 365 services

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive for Business, and Copilot

• Knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, and Microsoft Purview

• Fluency in written and spoken English

• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Customer-oriented thinking and high-quality standards

• The ability to collaborate effectively across functions and teams

• Curiosity, openness, and a willingness to share knowledge with others

**It would also be an advantage to have:

**

• Familiarity with cloud security and compliance standards

• Knowledge of networking and identity management in cloud environments

• Experience in the financial sector

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let's learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Development Manager Anne-Mette Bluhme at abz@bec.dk.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE ACOUSTIC ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

Every SOUNDBOKS starts with a great idea - but turning it into a speaker that can survive a festival, run for hours, and sound incredible takes a lot of engineering. As the Acoustic Engineer, you'll be taking charge of the acoustic development that helps bring those products to life.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

Concept & Prototype Development

• 
You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• 
You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• 
You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• 
You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

Simulation & Validation

• 
You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• 
You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• 
You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

Driver Specification & Verification

• 
You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

• 
You'll define driver specifications and tolerances.

• 
You'll support manufacturing verification with suppliers.

• 
You'll participate in the acoustic verification of the final product towards mass production.

• 
You'll collaborate with the Audio team on audio signal handling, including crossovers, compressors, and limiters.

In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

• 
You have proven experience designing and simulating loudspeakers, including transducer design and specification, enclosure design, and acoustic measurements.

• 
You hold a BSc or higher in Audio, Acoustics, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

• 
You've done loudspeaker simulation and measurements, and use both to validate and refine your designs.

• 
You've worked with loudspeaker development from concept through verification and ideally have experience collaborating with external manufacturing partners.

• 
Familiarity with crossover design, FEM simulations, or failure analysis is an advantage.

• 
Ideally you also have experience building physical speaker mock-ups or collaborating with large-scale loudspeaker manufacturing partners.

• 
You work independently, take ownership of your area, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers across disciplines.

• 
You're curious, creative, and constantly looking for ways to improve acoustic performance.

• 
You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have!

jobs.occupation: PostDoc - Uncertainty-Aware Optimization in Inverse Problems for Next-Generation 3D Scanning
jobs.description:
3Shape and DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at the Technical University of Denmark) invite applications for an Industrial Postdoctoral position partially funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The position is a 2-year fixed-term appointment starting in January 2027 (small variations in the start date may be possible depending on the candidate’s preference).

The project addresses a fundamental challenge in computational imaging and large-scale optimization: how can uncertainty in measurements be quantified, propagated, and ultimately leveraged to improve the reliability of reconstructed 3d models?

Modern 3D scanning systems rely on advanced optimization algorithms to reconstruct geometry and color from large volumes of sensor data. While these algorithms produce highly accurate results, they typically provide limited information about the confidence and uncertainty associated with the reconstructed output. Developing methods that can efficiently estimate and propagate uncertainty in the input data through large-scale iterative optimization algorithms has the potential to improve reconstruction quality, enable more informed algorithmic decisions, and support the next generation of intelligent scanning systems.

The successful candidate will conduct research at the intersection of numerical linear algebra, optimization, uncertainty quantification, and computational imaging. The project will investigate: (i) how to characterize measurement uncertainty, (ii) how uncertainty propagates through iterative solvers, (iii) how to develop new mathematical frameworks for uncertainty-aware optimization, and (iv) how to validate the proposed methods through simulations and deployment in medical 3D reconstruction algorithms developed at 3Shape.

The position offers a unique opportunity to combine fundamental research with industrial impact. Working closely with leading researchers at DTU and engineers at 3Shape, the candidate will contribute to scientific publications, software prototype development, and innovation activities aimed at strengthening the theoretical foundations and practical performance of future 3D scanning technologies.

About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.

This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.

About the project

The project is a 2-year project between 3Shape and the Technical University of Denmark, partly funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The academic co-supervisor will be Professor Per Christian Hansen at DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science).

The research focuses on uncertainty-aware methods for large-scale linear least squares problems, which form the mathematical backbone of many inverse problems and optimization tasks in 3D reconstruction. The objective is to develop new theoretical and computational tools for quantifying and propagating uncertainty through iterative solution methods, and to translate these developments into practical algorithms for medical 3D reconstruction systems.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will contribute both to the theoretical foundation and the practical implementation of next-generation uncertainty-aware reconstruction algorithms. The work spans mathematical modelling, algorithm design, and software development in a medical imaging 3D reconstruction.

You will:

• 
Develop methods for characterizing measurement uncertainty in medical 3D scanning data, including data-driven approaches and machine learning methods where appropriate, to obtain realistic and application-relevant uncertainty models.

• 
Work hands-on with numerical algorithms, including iterative methods such as Krylov subspace methods and related solvers.

• 
Develop and analyse new methods for uncertainty-aware linear least squares optimization, with a focus on large-scale iterative solvers.

• 
Design mathematical frameworks for quantifying how uncertainty evolves through optimization algorithms used in 3D reconstruction.

• 
Contribute to the architectural design of uncertainty-aware components within existing reconstruction pipelines.

• 
Translate theoretical models into efficient, scalable implementations suitable for industrial use.

• 
Design and run simulation studies to validate theoretical developments under realistic conditions.

• 
Collaborate with researchers and engineers to integrate new methods into production-oriented 3D scanning systems.

• 
Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, technical reports, and potential patentable innovations.

What We’re Looking For

• 
A PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. The PhD must have been awarded after March 2021 (or will be obtained within November 2026).

• 
Strong expertise in numerical linear algebra, optimization, and/or inverse problems.

• 
Solid understanding of linear least squares methods and iterative solvers, ideally methods based on Krylov subspace methods.

• 
Experience with or strong interest in uncertainty quantification, statistical modelling, or probabilistic methods.

• 
Strong programming skills in at least one programming language (ideally two), such as C#, C++, or Python.

• 
Familiarity with machine learning methods is an advantage, particularly for data-driven modelling of complex systems.

• 
Ability to work independently and take ownership of research problems while also contributing to a collaborative industrial-academic environment.

• 
Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex mathematical ideas clearly in both academic and applied settings.

What 3Shape offers

• 
A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 50 nationalities in our DK based office

• 
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Good work/life balance.

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
Purpose: Endeavor to improve dental patients on a global scale_.

Staying true to our values and D&I efforts, we encourage all relevant applicants to apply, and we ask you NOT to add any photos or sensitive information (age, marital status, nationality) during the application process.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

Summary

As an Entry-level Consultant at Oliver Wyman in Copenhagen, you will join a diverse project team to address complex client challenges. Responsibilities include conducting research, analysing data, preparing deliverables such as presentations and workshops, and supporting client decision-making. The role offers flexibility to specialise early, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to work across industries. Applicants must have a Bachelor’s degree (Master’s is also accepted), fluency in Danish or another Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Finnish), and English. The position values initiative, creativity, and strong analytical skills. Hybrid working and travel within the home market are part of the role. No specific industry experience or academic majors are required.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

• As a member of your project team you’ll work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients worldwide to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

• You’ll help teams understand client challenges by conducting research, gathering data, running surveys and interviews, and turning information into clear insights.

• You’ll analyze problems, identify patterns, test hypotheses, and help structure recommendations that support client decision-making.

• You’ll contribute to client-ready deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• You’ll build core consulting skills from the start, including how to structure your work, communicate clearly, contribute to team problem-solving, and manage your priorities.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

Develop as a leader

• From day one, be encouraged to take initiative, ask questions, and bring your perspective to the work.

• Learn how to structure problems, communicate clearly, and contribute to team discussions and client conversations.

• As you grow, you’ll have opportunities to build confidence, take on more responsibility, and develop the skills to unlock the potential of others.

Learn and grow without limits

• Learn on the job and through formal training, developing core skills in communication, presentation, analytics, problem-solving, and client management.

• Each project will give you new opportunities to learn from specialists, broaden your perspective, and build momentum in your career.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

Experience rewards that work for you

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

Who can apply?

• Applicants with a Bachelor´s (and Master’s) degree only are eligible to apply for this vacancy.

• We look for people who display initiative, intuition, and creativity with a strong problem solving and analytical mindset. We do not require specific academic majors or industry experience; we value diversity of experience and skills, extracurricular activities, and evidence of leading an interesting and impactful life outside of your studies.

• Language skills**:** Fluency in Danish or another Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Finnish), as well as English.

How to apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website. If you're having technical issues submitting your application or any questions, please reach out to recruiting.nordics@oliverwyman.com

What to expect during the interviews process?

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business.

If you want to learn more about consulting interviews and start your preparation, please visit our careers page: https://www.oliverwyman.com/careers/entry-level/interview-preparation.html

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Do you want to shape how life-changing medicines reach patients around the world? As Associate Director, Publishing & Archive, you will lead a highly specialised team responsible for ensuring global regulatory submissions are delivered with the highest levels of quality, compliance and operational excellence.

Position to be based in Søborg, Denmark.

This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership, strategic influence and regulatory expertise in a role that directly supports Novo Nordisk's mission of defeating serious chronic diseases.

**Your New Role

**As Associate Director, Publishing & Archive, you will provide leadership for a team responsible for global publishing activities and archiving. You will act as a key subject matter expert for electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) publishing, while helping to shape the future direction of the function through continuous improvement, operational excellence and strategic collaboration.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading, coaching and developing a high-performing team, creating clarity of direction, enabling growth and ensuring effective prioritisation of activities.

• Driving business performance through clear objectives, efficient resource utilisation and successful delivery of critical publishing milestones.

• Ensuring quality, compliance and environmental management standards are maintained through a robust local Quality Management System.

• Building strong partnerships across Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Reporting, R&D, Quality Assurance, DD&IT and senior leadership, while engaging with external authorities and industry stakeholders.

• Contributing to strategic decision-making and representing Novo Nordisk in external industry forums that help influence the future of regulatory operations and submission standards.

In this role, you will have a direct impact on the successful delivery of regulatory submissions worldwide, helping ensure that innovative medicines can reach the patients who need them.

**Your New Department.

**In Research & Development, you'll be part of a unit that explores bold scientific ideas and advances them into clinical testing. We combine curiosity, AI tools and human data to develop transformative therapies. Through collaboration and operational excellence, we shape and deliver an innovative pipeline to meet future patient needs.

Within R&D, the Publishing & Archive department is part of Regulatory, Quality & Clinical Reporting Operations (RQ&C Ops). The team plays a critical role in ensuring that regulatory submissions are compliant, accurately structured and delivered across major global health authority regions, including Europe, the United States, Japan and China.

In addition, the department oversees the archiving of regulatory and Trial Master File documentation in accordance with international regulatory requirements. As Associate Director, you will lead a team whose work directly contributes to bringing new medicines to patients around the world.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced leader who combines strong regulatory knowledge with the ability to inspire and develop people. You thrive in a complex stakeholder environment and enjoy balancing strategic priorities with operational execution.

**To Succeed In This Role, You Will Ideally Have

**

• A Master's degree and significant experience within regulatory operations, publishing, archiving or related pharmaceutical discipline, including leadership experience.

• Deep understanding of drug development processes, GxP requirements, and relevant global regulatory guidelines.

• Strong expertise in eCTD publishing and regulatory submission requirements across major health authorities such as EMA, FDA and PMDA.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders.

• A collaborative and resilient leadership style, with a passion for developing people, driving continuous improvement and delivering results with integrity.

**Working at Novo Nordisk

**Every day we seek solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity, and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**What We Offer

**Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000 to 1,245,100 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

**Contact

**For further information about the position, please contact Klaus Kjær Laigaard at KKJL@novonordisk.com

**Deadline

**

• October 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Please note that applications are screened on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo in your CV.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo we recognize that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to aspire to be the best company in the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Your impact begins here

**As Associate P&O Director, you will be the strategic People & Organisation partner to the Global Vice President of AI & Digital Innovation and an active member of the ADI leadership team. You will turn business priorities into clear people plans with owners, actions and measurable outcomes, shaping how the organisation is designed, led and developed. Your advice will help leaders build the capabilities, performance culture and organisational health ADI needs to move forward with clarity and speed.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an experienced P&O partner who is comfortable at the leadership table and confident enough to challenge it. You will bring:

• A relevant bachelor’s degree.

• 8+ years relevant HR experience, including 5+ years partnering with senior business leaders.

• Proven expertise across P&O areas such as organisational design and effectiveness, talent and succession, performance culture and workforce planning.

• Experience leading the people side of business change and transformation, such as M&A, organic growth or divestitures.

• Strong business and financial acumen, with the analytical skills to combine people data and business insight into practical recommendations.

• The ability to coach, challenge and influence senior leaders without formal authority, and to handle sensitive conversations with sound judgement and confidentiality.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

Desirable, but not essential: A Master’s degree, an HR professional certification, experience from the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry, regional experience, and an understanding of how digitalisation and AI are changing skills and work.

**What You’ll Do

**You will shape and drive the P&O agenda for ADI, working closely with leaders to turn strategy into action:

• Act as a trusted sparring partner to the GVP and leadership team, translating business strategy into P&O plans with clear priorities and measures of success, and leading the P&O part of strategic projects.

• Strengthen organisational effectiveness by assessing accountabilities, spans and layers, decision rights and interfaces, and by partnering with Finance on workforce scenarios, critical skills, capacity and people costs.

• Guide leaders through the annual P&O cycle, compensation, engagement, talent and succession, and performance reviews, ensuring consistent calibration, meaningful conversations and follow-through.

• Build a strong performance culture and an engaging, inclusive workplace by coaching leaders on feedback and accountability and using employee insights to act on root causes.

• Lead the people side of change and future capabilities, from readiness and adoption to succession, internal mobility, leadership onboarding and the reskilling needs created by digitalisation and AI.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join P&O Business Partnering, where colleagues help create an engaging, inclusive workplace and attract and develop the talent needed to support Novo’s purpose. You will report to the Director, Senior P&O Business Partner.

Your closest partners will be the ADI GVP, the ADI leadership team and line-of-business leaders. Job Description: What if your next data engineering challenge wasn't building one more solution - but shaping how 150 data engineers build theirs? At Tryg, we are bringing our analytical, AI and pricing landscape together around Databricks and building a stronger, shared engineering foundation across Scandinavia.

We are looking for a Principal Data Engineer to define what great Data Engineering looks like across Tryg - and turn those principles into frameworks, tooling and ways of working that engineers use.

You will get a broad technical mandate, significant autonomy and the opportunity to shape how Data Engineering develops across Tryg.

About the role | Shape Data Engineering across Tryg

As Principal Data Engineer, you will lead the development of Data Engineering Excellence across Tryg. Your focus goes beyond solving individual engineering challenges. You will establish the standards, reference solutions and reusable patterns that enable our teams to build reliable, scalable and maintainable data solutions.

Working closely with Platform Engineering, Lead Data Engineers, Data Architects and Principal colleagues across AI and Pricing, you will:

• Define and evolve engineering standards across development, testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, dependency management and the use of GenAI.

• Develop reference implementations and reusable patterns that can be adopted across teams.

• Co-create frameworks, automation and platform capabilities with Platform Engineering.

• Help shape Tryg's core data architecture and engineering principles.

• Drive adoption and raise technical maturity through guidance, coaching and knowledge sharing.

A key part of your role is turning technical direction into real change. Success isn't a standard documented somewhere - it is better engineering practices becoming part of how 150+ data engineers work.

The role is an individual contributor but participates in the Data Enablement leadership team; to ensure long term decisions are anchored with deep engineering knowledge.

About you | A strong engineer who makes other engineers better

You have a strong technical background and have spent a significant part of your career designing and building complex, production-grade data solutions. Over time, your perspective has expanded from solving individual engineering problems to improving how engineering is done across teams.

You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can structure complex problems, bring together different perspectives, evaluate trade-offs and make technical decisions when alignment cannot be reached.

We imagine that you bring:

• Strong Data Engineering and software engineering fundamentals.

• Experience establishing engineering standards, frameworks or reusable patterns.

• The technical depth to make difficult decisions and explain the trade-offs behind them.

• Experience influencing senior engineers and technical leaders across teams.

• Experience driving adoption at scale - not simply defining standards but changing how teams actually work.

• Ability to think in systems – not just for technical challenges, but also how you solve interaction with large communities

Experience with Databricks, modern data platforms and cloud engineering is highly relevant. Experience from a regulated organization is an advantage, but not a requirement.

You don't need to be the deepest specialist in every data discipline. Your focus will be engineering excellence: how we design, develop, test, deploy, operate and continuously improve data solutions on a large scale – both in data volumes and complexity.

About us | Build the foundation while it is still being shaped

Tryg is one of Scandinavia's largest non-life insurance companies, serving more than 5 million customers across Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

You will join Data Enablement and become part of our strategic technical leadership. Strong engineering practices already exist across Tryg - your opportunity is to help turn the best of them into common approaches that can scale across teams.

There is no finished blueprint waiting for you to maintain. Many of the foundational choices are still being made, giving you the opportunity to leave a significant fingerprint on how Data Engineering is done at Tryg for years to come.

Employee benefits | Something to look forward to

At Tryg, we offer attractive conditions and employee benefits, including:

• An attractive pension scheme.

• General bonus programme.

• Health and dental insurance.

• Five weeks of holiday, five additional holiday days and four extra days off.

• Flexible ways of working with trust and responsibility.

You will also become part of a strong professional community with highly skilled colleagues across Tryg.

**Recruitment process | Show us how you think

**As part of the recruitment process, you will work with a case based on an open engineering challenge. We are less interested in one theoretically perfect answer and more interested in how you approach ambiguity, evaluate technical trade-offs and turn technical direction into something that can successfully be adopted at scale.

**We look forward to hearing from you

We review applications continuously and will close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

We encourage everyone regardless of gender identity, age, background, disability or origin to apply for the position. jobs.occupation: Software Engineer – Power Plant Control & Grid Measurement
jobs.description:
关于职务

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our Development Denmark team in a role focused on validating and qualifying grid measurement systems used in wind park control applications. Your day may start in the laboratory testing Elspec G4K/G4N grid meters, evaluating measurement accuracy and communication performance under different operating conditions. You will work hands-on with measurement hardware, analyze complex datasets, and develop automated test solutions using Python and MATLAB.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, SCADA, and supplier teams, you will help ensure that grid measurement systems meet performance, reliability, and security requirements. Your work will directly contribute to supplier evaluations and the successful integration of measurement technologies within wind power plant control solutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• 
Validate and evaluate grid measurement devices used in wind park control systems, with a primary focus on Elspec G4K/G4N meters, supporting supplier qualification and technology assessments.

• 
Design, execute, and automate test campaigns using Python and/or MATLAB, including integration with Omicron signal generators, measurement equipment, data acquisition systems, and structured CI/CD testing frameworks.

• 
Troubleshoot measurement hardware, communication interfaces, and laboratory test setups to identify, analyze, and resolve performance issues.

• 
Analyze measurement data from devices, SCADA systems, and SQL databases, transforming results into clear technical insights, reports, visualizations, and recommendations that support engineering decisions.

• 
Verify secure communication and cybersecurity requirements, including protocols such as Modbus/TLS and Syslog/TLS, certificate-based authentication, secure onboarding, logging and telemetry capabilities, and compliance with IEC 62443 and emerging Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) requirements.

What You Bring

• 
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, combined with relevant professional engineering experience.

• 
Experience working with electrical measurement systems, power systems, data acquisition equipment, or similar industrial technologies, including structured troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

• 
Proficiency in Python application development for test automation, data analysis, and software development, with a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

• 
Experience with CI/CD practices, agile development methodologies, C# and/or C++.

• 
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• 
Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, cybersecurity principles, and secure system integration, including areas such as PKI certificates, authentication mechanisms, secure communication interfaces, or IEC 62443-based environments.

About the Team

You will join the Development Denmark team, where engineers collaborate to validate grid measurement systems used in wind park control and power plant environments. The team combines hands-on laboratory testing with advanced data analysis to assess performance, troubleshoot technical challenges, and support supplier evaluations.

Knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and open collaboration are an integral part of the team's way of working. While the role offers a high degree of ownership and independent responsibility, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who work together to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver trusted measurement solutions.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• 
Opportunities to work with a global team

• 
Medical benefits

• 
Remote/Flexible work

• 
Paid holidays and parental leave

• 
Employer-funded pension

• 
Subsidised lunch and more
